about_the_game:
The Art of Mastering Time: Carving Out a Path to Life in a Static World

In this game, time is your most powerful weapon and shield. You do not rely on brute force to crush the enemy, but rather on precise timing control to defuse crises and defeat the enemy in the ever-changing battlefield.

【 Time-stop Force Field 】 : The strategic core that governs the battle situation

Actively trigger the time freeze, freezing the surging offensive in an instant. This is not only an escape window to dodge a fatal blow, but also the combat command post for you to launch a perfect counterattack. Observe calmly, formulate strategies, and then defeat the enemy in one fell fell.

【 High-speed Mode 】 : A high-speed game that reverses life and death

When you need ultimate precision rather than overall control, activate the high-speed mode. In this state, your movements are as swift as ghosts. You can see through the enemy's opening move in milliseconds and interrupt their strongest ultimate move first.

【 Integrated Offense and Defense 】 : The magnificent skill from blocking to counterattacking

Battle is far from just about offense. Master Parry and turn the enemy's strength into your own. Seize the perfect opportunity to block and create a huge flaw. Even engage in a fierce battle with the BOSS or use a sharp blade to cut down bullets. Your skills determine the magnificence of the battle.

【 Twin Weapons 】 : A freely switchable killing rhythm

Katana: Pursuing speed and combo attacks, tearing apart enemies like a gust of wind and thunder.

Great Sword: Pursuing power and suppression, ending the battle with a devastating blow.

Switch freely according to the battle situation, seamlessly connect the two combat styles, and deliver smooth and fluid Combo attacks.

【 Smart Opponent 】 : Every battle is an immersive dialogue

Your enemy possesses "wisdom". They will keenly observe your fighting style and provide real-time verbal feedback and teasing on your brilliant moves or mistakes, making every battle full of immersive interaction and challenges, as if you were going head-to-head with a real opponent.

This game was completed independently by an individual.

【Game Content】
The world is so vast. I want to see it - even if it costs the whole world. ​​

She was once the shadow forgotten in the corner of the village, a girl daydreaming. The only belief was to swing the rusty iron sword in her hand day after day, dreaming that one day she could cut through the mountains that had trapped her and see the vast world depicted in the poems.

When the sweat finally paid off for recognition and the dawn of hope was just around the corner, disaster quietly descended. The familiar villagers behaved strangely overnight, and the familiar village was shrouded in inexplicable whispers.

Now, she must hold fast to the sword that was originally intended to open up the future, confront her closest relatives who have fallen into madness, and search for the truth in the fog.

Is it to protect this place that has nurtured her but also imprisoned her? Or, regardless of everything, go after that tiny yet scorching light? ​​

Her dream, your choice. ​

short_description: Freely combine mechanisms such as "Time Stop", "Rebound", and "Execution" to create your own unique swordsmanship school. Multiple weapons, over 10 skills, and unlimited possibilities for combination. The BOSS will mock your mistakes and also recognize your actions to respond accordingly
